## Problem
What practical detection-engineering or threat-hunting problem does this address?

## Proposed approach
Describe the smallest useful change.

## Evidence or references
Include sanitized evidence or relevant ATT&CK references.

## Validation
How could the change be tested, and what would it not prove?

## Data and licensing
Confirm the proposal does not require publishing restricted telemetry or unlicensed material.
